title: Rate limiting exists but only applied to 1 of 17 API routes
description: Rate limiter exists in src/lib/rate-limit.ts with pre-configured limits for auth/api/sensitive/webhook namespaces. However, only src/app/api/webhooks/n8n/route.ts uses it. 16 other routes including auth/register, scan, tenders/analyze, organizations, and admin endpoints are unprotected against brute-force and abuse.
verified_state: rate-limit.ts EXISTS with checkRateLimit(), getClientIp(), and RATE_LIMITS config. Only used in webhooks/n8n/route.ts.

title: No input validation on several API routes
description: Audit flagged missing input validation at middleware level. While Zod is used in some forms, multiple API route handlers lack request body/query parameter validation, allowing malformed or malicious payloads.
audit_quote: Lipsă: validare input la nivel de middleware

title: CSRF protection missing on custom API routes
description: No Origin/Referer header validation on state-changing custom API routes (POST/PUT/DELETE). NextAuth v5 with JWT strategy mitigates session-based CSRF but custom routes using Bearer tokens or session cookies still need defense-in-depth protection.
verified_state: middleware.ts EXISTS with security headers (X-Frame-Options, CSP, HSTS) but no Origin validation for CSRF

title: Google OAuth redirect URIs not configured in Google Cloud Console
description: NextAuth Google provider code is complete. Redirect URIs https://seap.knowbest.ro/api/auth/callback/google and https://seap-assistant.vercel.app/api/auth/callback/google must be added in Google Cloud Console. Users cannot use Google login.
audit_quote: Google OAuth incomplet — redirect URI neconfigurate în Google Cloud Console
note: EXTERNAL FIX — requires Google Cloud Console access, not a code change

title: Anthropic API credits exhausted on Vercel
description: AI analysis on Vercel falls back to rule-based fallback due to exhausted Anthropic API credits. Claude CLI is not available in serverless environment. Analysis quality significantly degraded.
audit_quote: Anthropic API credits epuizate — analiza AI pe Vercel cade pe rule-based
note: EXTERNAL FIX — requires Anthropic billing top-up, not a code change

title: OCR service unavailable on Vercel serverless
description: OCR depends on local FastAPI service on port 8000 — works on VPS but completely unavailable on Vercel. Documents cannot be processed on serverless deployment. No graceful fallback or user messaging.
audit_quote: OCR funcționează doar pe VPS (serviciu local port 8000), nu pe Vercel
note: Architecture limitation — needs serverless OCR alternative or graceful degradation

title: n8n.4pro.io DNS A record not configured
description: n8n integration workflow JSON exists but the n8n instance on VPS1 has no DNS A record. External scanner integration is non-functional.
note: EXTERNAL FIX — requires DNS provider configuration

title: No monitoring, health check, or alerting for production
description: No error tracking (Sentry), no health check endpoint, no uptime monitoring, no alerting on API errors or cron failures. Production errors go unnoticed. PM2 provides only basic process monitoring on VPS.

title: No API documentation (Swagger/OpenAPI)
description: 17 API endpoints exist without formal documentation. No swagger.json, openapi.yml, or JSDoc annotations. Blocks third-party integrations and developer onboarding.

title: README.md is generic create-next-app template
description: README.md has not been customized. Actual project description only in knowledge/project-overview.md. New developers have no entry point.

title: knowledge/project-overview.md outdated (last: 2026-02-07)
description: Knowledge base last updated 2026-02-07. Does not reflect March 2026 work: Cloudflare R2 storage, dual deployment (VPS2 + Vercel), cron jobs, Claude AI 3-tier fallback, production status.
